selection.labels: literal source MIDI and metadata only

interpretation: This weak aggregate-stem template diagnostic missed every required onset gate. The 283553792-byte figure is total Windows process working set, not incremental RSS and not an ARM measurement, so it cannot prove failure of the plan's <=256 MiB incremental-RSS target. It does not establish that other model-based architectures are infeasible.
limitations: The aggregate DRUM stem is weak MIDI-window supervision, not per-lane isolated audio.
Track00017 development BASS source MIDI was absent and excluded rather than inferred from audio.
The preliminary corpus is not the required acceptance corpus and no grid F1 was measured.
